entry.title: Mylo the Cat Pivots to Pickleball - Episode 5 - My Mom and I Get The Win on Long Island!

media:group.media:title: Mylo the Cat Pivots to Pickleball - Episode 5 - My Mom and I Get The Win on Long Island!
media:group.media:description:
Episode 5 of Mylo the Cat pivoting to Pickleball, while trying to figure out what the heck to do after a successful 20-year Video Editing career appears to be coming to an end. This week we’re heading out to Old Bethpage on Long Island to play at the US Academy of Pickleball (https://www.instagram.com/us_academy_of_pickleball) and admire the ‘great’ sights along the way! I’m very happy to have my Mom on, along with our family friend Kris, and another family friend/club pro Rob McKenna (https://www.instagram.com/mckennapickleball), who’s a next-level player. We’ve all played together a bunch of times, but this is the first time on camera, so this one really counts!
We get some back story on everyone’s Pickleball journeys with my Mom, her friend Kris, and club pro Rob from the US Academy of Pickleball in Nassau County. We then play in Match 2, as Rob and Kris try to avenge their first ever loss to my Mom and I, a real mixed doubles pickleball battle!
In the final match, my Mom and I end the day with a win! Full disclosure, we lost several matches that weren’t seen in this episode due to time constraints, but we still played the best we ever did as a duo. Big thanks again to Kris and club pro Rob McKenna. I also play here in an intense men’s DUPR game on Tuesday nights, so another full Long Island episode is on the way soon.
I’m still in the early phases of the process of really doing this, going all-in! Follow my new Pickleball page on IG - https://www.instagram.com/mylopickleball and https://www.facebook.com/mylopickleball

entry.title: Mylo the Cat Pivots to Pickleball - Episode 4 - 4.0 vs. 5.9

media:group.media:title: Mylo the Cat Pivots to Pickleball - Episode 4 - 4.0 vs. 5.9
media:group.media:description:
Episode 4 of Mylo the Cat (https://www.instagram.com/mylopickleball) pivoting to Pickleball, while trying to figure out what the heck to do after a successful 20-year Video Editing career appears to be coming to an end. We had a ton of footage from this day, so I had more than enough to make another full episode! We start with a little backstory on my Lead Producer, Cousin Ethan (@ejgany), then get honest feedback on my game from Ryan (https://www.instagram.com/weinbach.pickleball) from Podplay (https://www.instagram.com/podplay_official), Newton (@newts_mcgoots) and Paul. All of this was once again at my go-to place in Long Island City, Gotham Pickleball (https://www.instagram.com/gotham.pickle). I can’t thank them enough for letting me film this there! We’re taking this show on the road in the New York area, so invite me to your club and we’ll get an episode in. Fair warning though, I’ve already improved since this video was filmed, so be prepared for me to bring it…
We then change the teams, so myself and the great Newton take on Ryan Weinbach from Podplay and Pauly Paul. We know we can’t beat Ryan (yet) but Newton and I gave these guys a run for their money! Paul and I then team up to try to get some more points off the pro. Pro Pickleball player Ryan estimates that Paul, Newton, and I are rated in between 3.5 and 4.0 on DUPR, which is very accurate but I think we’re all definitely approaching 4.0! We’re then joined by Amanda (https://www.instagram.com/amanda.pickleball), one of the great club pros at Gotham in LIC. She’s been a huge help in my fast improvement at Open Play, but now she’s going to help me with some points off the pro. If you’re looking to get better, reach out to her on Instagram immediately, she’ll definitely make you better! We recap the whole day and get final thoughts. I got a whole bunch of new challengers and teammates on the way next, but I’m hoping to get each of these folks from this episode back for another as well!
I’m still in the early phases of the process of really doing this, going all-in! Follow my new Pickleball page on IG - https://www.instagram.com/mylopickleball and https://www.facebook.com/mylopickleball

media:group.media:title: Mylo the Cat Pivots to Pickleball - Episode 3 - Surprising Friends With a Secret Pro (5.9 Rating)
media:group.media:description:
Episode 3 of Mylo the Cat pivoting to Pickleball, while trying to figure out what the heck to do after a successful 20-year Video Editing career appears to be coming to an end. I’m figuring it all out as I go along, but this episode is much closer to what this show is going to be! I’m playing with a “secret pro” Ryan Weinbach (@weinbach.pickleball) who happens to be a 5.9 and playing in this year’s Pro US Open. He’s also the Director of Sales at PodPlay (@podplay_official) the best Pickleball App/Service, that also is the power behind on-court replays, literally the best feature I’ve seen at the clubs.
We’re playing at my go-to place in Long Island City, Gotham Pickleball (@gotham.pickle), with two of my favorite people to play with, Paul, who’s now a regular on this show, and a first time appearance from my buddy Newton (@newts_mcgoots) who happens to be one of the best players at Gotham Open Play!
Ryan gives us some more background on his legendary Pickleball family, including his Father, Dave Weinbach aka The Badger. Newton and Paul obviously knew I was a video creator but I then revealed that I actually have a Million followers on (my main) Instagram page, so I’m not just some schlub, I’m a schlub with a large following!
Last but not least, the production quality is finally starting to improve, all thanks to my Lead Producer/Cameraman/Cousin Ethan (@ejgany). We got a bunch of matches in and a ton of footage, so there will be another full episode from this day coming very soon!

media:group.media:title: Mylo the Cat Pivots to Pickleball - Episode 2 - Gotham Pickleball Open Play
media:group.media:description:
Episode 2 of Mylo the Cat (@mylothecat) pivoting to Pickleball, while trying to figure out what the heck to do after a successful 20-year Video Editing career appears to be coming to an end. These episodes are going to improve a lot, stick with me! Next one I have my Cousin Ethan coming on as the Lead Producer, so I got a cameraman, and mics, plus a club pro, and a Pickleball touring pro, as well as some great challengers.
This week, I’m heading back to another Open Play at my go-to place, Gotham Pickleball in Long Island City. I took the New York City subway over there from Queens, and love mixing in the sights of the journey and the neighborhoods. The goal is to play all over NYC (not just Open Plays), and New York, then eventually around the country. I got challengers coming in from my DMs on Social Media, so hit me up if you want to play with or against me!
Again, I’ve only been playing Pickleball for 6 months, but I genuinely love it, and I’m improving really quickly, especially considering that I only play twice a week. I’ve been going through some tough times in both my career and my life, so I’d love for this series to be huge, but if it’s not, it’s all good. I’m really just trying to get in shape, and create something cool that keeps me motivated to keep creating, and keeps my mental health in check.

entry.title: Mylo the Cat Pivots to Pickleball - Episode 1 - NYC Open Play Pickleball

media:group.media:title: Mylo the Cat Pivots to Pickleball - Episode 1 - NYC Open Play Pickleball
media:group.media:description:
My name is Adam Schleichkorn, but some of you may know me better as Mylo the Cat (@mylothecat). After a successful 20-year Video Editing career, it’s becoming very clear that AI is on the verge of replacing people like me, so it’s time for a change! I’ve only been playing Pickleball for 6 months, and am improving at a rapid pace…
I’m not a pro. In fact, nowhere near a pro, but I’m documenting my journey and improvement along the way. This is just the first test episode, filmed by myself. As we go on, I’m going to get some help with a cameraman and producer, and get mics for the on-court action, so the quality and content will both improve considerably as well. I play regularly in Long Island City at Gotham Pickleball, but as this show expands, I want to bring it all over New York City and beyond.
I put out some stories on Social Media and already have some great challengers lined up! Eventually, I’d love for this to become a destination to promote your work or services, but ultimately it’s just about having fun, getting in shape, and improving on the courts and on the edits. If you want to come play with or against me, reach out any time!
This first episode takes place in NYC at the previously mentioned Gotham Pickleball. This is an Open Play session on the “Advanced” courts, and the word on the street is that this is tougher competition than most New York City Open Plays. I’m not saying it’s the toughest, but come challenge me and one of the other regulars and find out!
In all of my years creating videos, I’ve never done vlog style stuff like this and really have barely ever even been on camera. Go easy on me, there are already plans in place to make these things much better. I filmed a couple new episodes since this one, and I’m already learning from my mistakes, so stick with me. Whether you’re an avid Pickleball fan or not, I think everyone can relate to improvement caused directly by hard work, so that’s what this is going to be about.

entry.title: SVOY The Animated Series - Episode 25 (Season 1 Finale)

media:group.media:title: SVOY The Animated Series - Episode 25 (Season 1 Finale)
media:group.media:description:
Episode 25 of the original SVOY Series, aka the Shortest Video on Youtube Series, starring Mylo the Cat! I tried re-formatted this series into 25 parts and it failed epically, but I genuinely loved making it! I can't stress enough how tough it is to compete with big channels with staff and budgets, along with the never-ending AI content now too. I always think about making a comeback on here though... Either way, all of you who used to watch these short videos every single day is why I kept making them, so I can't thank everyone enough! Between work and life and getting old, it's tough to make the time for a huge new series, but again, I'm always thinking about new ideas, so I might make something happen.
(Warning Spoilers) Check the official Wiki for a ton of additional information about the series, story, characters, voice actors, and more - https://mylothecat.miraheze.org/wiki/Main_Page
This definitely requires some backstory, so here goes… Over 12 years ago, I posted the original Shortest Video on Youtube video, followed by 13 additional installments. 10 years after posting the original, it somehow went majorly viral, so in 2021, I started posting new parts of these short cat videos. From there, I was getting bored with the format, so I decided to do a little (poorly) animated 15-episode arc. People liked it, so over the course of the last 2 years, I kept expanding this story told in very short parts, ultimately into a full world that got way out of control! All stitched together, this created an eventual full-length movie and/or series.

media:group.media:title: SVOY The Animated Series - Episode 24
media:group.media:description:
Episode 24 of the original SVOY Series, aka the Shortest Video on Youtube Series, starring Mylo the Cat! After all of this time, Mylo and Rylo finally have their big one-on-one fight, with everyone else standing by watching! It was a tough back and forth battle, but Mylo emerges as the victor. He then orders Lulu and Barry to grab Rylo’s phone, and yells at everyone else to stop with the commotion. Jesse is then seen making a mysterious phone call, alerting an unknown person about their location.
Mylo finds Rylo’s sister’s number in his phone and calls her immediately. She answers thinking it’s her brother, but instead it’s Mylo, who explains that they captured Rylo and his Father, reveals their location, and offers a trade for his Papa. Rylo’s Sister and the Evil Villainess turn their car around and head back towards the main strip. As Mylo makes a light threat, she reveals that she doesn’t care about her brother’s safety, and that they have different fathers, and Chad is not her Dad. Rylo is very upset by this and pleads with his sister, as he feels as if he’s in serious danger. She still doesn’t care and hangs up the phone, as Rylo reveals her name for the first time as he yells, “Karen!”
Mylo then explains that they were never planning on seriously injuring them, and Barkley reveals the same from both sides. They just wanted to beat each other up a little bit. Barkley mentions how dangerous the Evil Villainess is but Rylo then asks about Mylo’s Papa, telling him that he’s the most dangerous of them all. All of a sudden, Willmeister shows up pointing out that it’s every wanted criminal in the city standing there, and Barkley accuses Mylo of snitching on them. Willy gives a passionate speech and tells all the bad guys to line up, until he stops abruptly and gets nervous and hides behind everyone. We hear that a car pull up and then the Evil Villainess’ theme music, and then she comes walking up with Karen, and then the episode ends! What’s going to happen? We’ll find out next time!

media:group.media:title: SVOY The Animated Series - Episode 23
media:group.media:description:
Episode 23 of the original SVOY Series, aka the Shortest Video on Youtube Series, starring Mylo the Cat! The Mylo Squad and Rylo’s crew stare each other down from across the street. Rylo starts bantering with Mylo in a threatening manner, until he realizes that Mylo has his father tied up on the ground behind him. Rylo points out that bring his father into this is taking things way too far, and Barkley yells that the Mylo Squad are definitely the bad guys, with Barry firing back calling the Rylo Crew the bad guys. Rylo then calls out the Swim Team, as they’ve been cool with each other in the past, but Jesse and Sneed tell him they’re done with them, and would’ve put a stop to their evil ways sooner if they knew what they were up to. Ilene chimes in saying that they didn’t know Rylo’s Crew were bad guys, causing all of them to get even angrier.
Mylo stops the back and forth to point out that Rylo took his Papa first, which Rylo denies. Just when Rylo and Mylo are about to fight, both extended crews go charging at each other, and a huge brawl erupts in the street. In Fight 1, we have Wally, DJ Hypersloth, Hawk, Yak, and Gamerboy vs. The Duck Duck Goose Gang and the Honey B’s. Fight 2 consists of The Swim Team and Garry vs. The Hellfish and Officer Thotamus. Fight 3 features Dewey, Bob Stretch, Casey Chipmunk, and Petey Penguin vs. The Bird Gang. Meanwhile, Suzie, Keith, and Brandon are in a taxi pulling up to Big Al’s Diner, and are surprised to see a huge fight in the middle of the street. Once inside the diner, they see Al and friends beaten up, and Susie decides that’s it, she’s calling the police.
Back on the street, Lulu the Cat is fighting both Calum Bullock and James the Snake. Across from them, we see Barry vs. Barkley, one-on-one. Once Barry gets the upper hand, Rylo comes charging at him. Mylo sees this and starts running in the same direction. Barry flies away at the last second, so Rylo and Mylo then come face-to-face, about to fight. What’s going to happen? We’ll find out next episode!
